scope: Isolated simulator fixture only. No camera, microphone, playback, model calls, PTZ or real learner data.

request.question: 停车阈值怎样影响停车位置？ / How does the threshold affect stopping?

conditions.name: 同一小车、速度和地面 / Same rover, speed and floor

pending_plan.text: 保持其他条件，试 30 cm / Keep other conditions and try 30 cm

tasks.zh: 从活动页打开比较表，不需展开诊断；A/B 状态初始未选择，计划接受未选。
tasks.en: Open the comparison form on the activity page without diagnostics. A/B statuses are initially unselected and plan acceptance is unchecked.

tasks.zh: 输入合成示例并保存。回看 A 的原始结果与未知次数，B 明确未测试；不触发提问、长期记忆或实验完成。
tasks.en: Save the synthetic example. A retains the original result and unknown count; B is explicitly untested. No question, memory promotion or completion is triggered.

tasks.zh: 有结果的 A 改为尚未测试。结果不被自动删除，保存提示清空或改回；明确清空后才发 null。
tasks.en: Change A with an existing result to untested. Keep its text and require explicit clearing or restoring the status before saving null.

tasks.zh: 明确接受待测计划后保存。只显示已接受且仍待实施，不声称完成或学会。
tasks.en: Explicitly accept and save a pending plan. Show accepted and still pending, without claiming completion or mastery.

tasks.zh: 隔离 fixture 中延迟或丢弃 POST 响应，再原样重试。使用同一 submission_id，列表仅一条；不再次取消新的教学。
tasks.en: In the isolated fixture, delay or lose the POST response, then retry unchanged. Keep the submission ID and one record; do not cancel newer teaching again.

tasks.zh: 提交后立即修改问题；延迟成功或失败回执均保留新编辑。再次保存实际新编辑使用新 ID。
tasks.en: Edit the question while saving. A delayed success or failure preserves newer edits; saving those edits uses a new ID.

tasks.zh: 未保存时尝试结束、新建活动、切换或创建档案。仍留当前活动，定位表单并提示保存或清空；输入框内容不丢。
tasks.en: With a dirty draft, try finishing, starting another session or switching/creating a profile. Stay in the session, focus the form and request save or clear; preserve the composer.

tasks.zh: 受控外部切会话后返回，旧 owner/epoch 回执不展示。旧列表 GET 不覆盖刚保存记录或恢复失效来源。
tasks.en: After a controlled external session switch and return, discard old owner/epoch replies. An older GET cannot erase a save or restore invalidated sources.

tasks.zh: 有草稿时改界面英语、切换阅读程度。草稿和原始结果原文不变；不改变教学语言；technical 显示明确变量术语。
tasks.en: Change UI language and reading level with a draft. Preserve draft and result wording and teaching language; technical mode uses the variable label.

tasks.zh: 模拟档案仅显示模拟来源，所有记录未经硬件验证。结束后的会话只可回看最近 10 组；人工报告确认不标成客观验证。
tasks.en: Simulation shows only the simulated source; all records are not hardware verified. Finished sessions are read-only with at most 10 records; human report confirmation is not objective verification.

tasks.zh: 保存期间不回执旧隐藏教学或自动读，停止仍可用。即使 POST 响应丢失，也等当前 state 刷新后再开放。
tasks.en: During saving, gate teaching display receipts and automatic reading while keeping Stop available. After a lost POST response, wait for current state before releasing the gate.

tasks.zh: 在窄宽布局逐项键盘操作。标签、错误、长英文和 A/B 卡片不溢出；定位未保存表单可见。草稿刷新会丢失的说明可见。
tasks.en: Use keyboard controls at narrow and wide widths. Check labels, errors, long English and A/B cards for overflow, focus visibility, and the page-refresh draft-loss notice.
